messages:
maria: Heads-up — planned minimal image cutover tomorrow 09:00 PDT. We're moving to a new signing flow that uses the HSM-backed KMS key. Need RBAC changes, audit streaming to Splunk, and a quick vuln triage before we flip canary. Any blockers?

devon: +1. Which key and which service account will sign? also: will the runtime need updated cosign config? :eyes:

maria: Key is project://redwood-prod/keys/container-signer (HSM). Service acct is ci-signer@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com. Runtime needs to be able to verify signatures (cosign) and we want canary gate that fails to fallback to previous image if verify fails.

rahul: I can add the IAM binding. We should grant only KMS AsymmetricSign to the service account and separate a key for rotation. Sample binding:```yaml
bindings:
  - role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
    members:
      - serviceAccount:ci-signer@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Replace role with roles/cloudkms.signer if using dedicated signer role on your cloud.

maria: thanks — will you also add a conditional that only allows signing from the CI pool IPs? we want smallest blast radius.

rahul: yep can do conditional binding on serviceAccount/commonName or sourceIp. I'll open the PR.

sophie: Audit side: we need KMS usage logs + cosign verification events routed to splunk:index=security_audit. Can you add a durable pub/sub -> logforwarder so we don't lose events during migration? Also require the log schema to include key_id, signer_sa, image_digest.

devon: runtime notes: canary job will run a verification step:```bash
cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/123/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/container-signer image:sha256:abcd
```
If verify fails, the canary should automatically rollback and report to #release-war-room. We also need to bump the cosign image in our sidecar.

oncall-bot: ALERT: canary-3 failed cosign verification (image:sha256:abcd) at 2025-06-12T09:03:14Z — verification error: public key not found.

maria: OK that alert is expected on the dry-run today — we need a plan to backfill public keys across registries. Can we host the public key in the artifacts bucket and fetch at startup?

devon: yes — runtime can fetch a key bundle from gs://redwood-public-keys/container-signer.pub and cache. we'll add a startup probe that fails fast if verify can't find a key.

maria: separate security note: during image scan we found CVE-2025-0421 in a tiny utility in the base image (busybox variant). It's low CVSS but present in multiple layers. Plan: rebase to patched base and rebuild, then resign. ETA for rebuild+canary: 4 hours. Any objections?

rahul: rebase + resign flow is ok. Just FYI — when you rotate the key, older images signed with previous key must remain verifiable; keep old public keys in the bundle for 90 days. Also we'll add an audit tag in KMS:labels: {"deploy": "minimal-cutover"}.

sophie: please include a post-deploy checklist for compliance: mapping of audit IDs -> ticket, SOC alerting rule, and a short incident playbook in case signature verification starts failing in prod. If you rollback, file a blameless postmortem.

maria: will do. Draft checklist items: 1) PR for IAM change merged + approved, 2) Pub/Sub -> splunk forwarder deployed, 3) public-key bundle uploaded, 4) runtime sidecar bump, 5) canary verify + rollback smoke, 6) vuln patch rebuild signed.

devon: I'll own steps 2,3,4,5.

rahul: I'll own IAM change and key policy.

sophie: I'll own audit mapping and validation tests.

maria: timeline: start rebuild at 09:00 PDT, canary at 13:00 PDT, full rollout at 16:00 PDT. If any of the verification steps fail, we abort and rollback.

devon: noted. pushing a quick runbook to the PR. small snippet for verification job:```yaml
verify-job:
  image: cosign/cosign:1.14.0
  command: ["cosign", "verify", "--key", "gcpkms://projects/.../cryptoKeys/container-signer", "${IMAGE}"]
```

maria: thanks all. please ack in thread once your PRs are green. Will update #release-war-room at T-30. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: NOTE: playbook pinned to thread for 24h.
